gteki_gate_array_2.note: REPRESENTATIVE, NOT A SURVEY. The data fixes only each gate node and its verified edge. The smallest neutral array (2 aisles, 1.86 m x 1.9 m, bidirectional, not the one-way piece) is placed once per node: local -Z (the aisles) along the verified edge's last segment as it arrives, the first aisle's centre (local x = -0.41) at mid-depth (0.95 m) on the node, so the edge runs down an aisle and does not cross a cabinet. Aisle count, direction, width and side are guesses. Visual only: no collider, not in walkable, not in the walk graph.
